---
title: "Observable 1.0 syntax: `{ojs1}`"
---

`{ojs1}` cells use the syntax of original Observable notebooks and Quarto 1's
`{ojs}` cells, compiled with Notebook Kit's `ojs` mode.

## Inputs with `viewof`

```{ojs1}
viewof radius = Inputs.range([5, 50], {value: 20, step: 1, label: "Radius"})
```

```{ojs1}
area = Math.round(Math.PI * radius ** 2)
```

```{ojs1}
html`<svg width=120 height=120><circle cx=60 cy=60 r=${radius} fill="steelblue"></circle></svg>`
```

## Mutable state

```{ojs1}
mutable clicks = 0
```

```{ojs1}
{
  const button = html`<button>Click me</button>`;
  button.onclick = () => ++mutable clicks;
  return button;
}
```

```{ojs1}
md`The button has been clicked **${clicks}** times.`
```

## Libraries

The standard library provides `d3`, `Plot`, `Inputs` and others. Quarto 1's
`require` works too, for UMD packages on npm:

```{ojs1}
d3array = require("d3-array@3")
```

```{ojs1}
d3array.sum([1, 2, 3, 4])
```

Static `import` in `{ojs1}` cells loads Observable notebooks, as it did in
Quarto 1:

```{ojs1}
import {chart} from "@d3/bar-chart"
```

```{ojs1}
chart
```
